entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: A long, thin north-south continent on Dominaria, the primary location for the Odyssey and Onslaught blocks.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Otaria lies.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A powerful artifact whose influence mutated Otaria's people and whose battle devastated the continent.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A power that controlled the continent's eastern region and made undead common.

entities.name: Mer Empire
entities.description: A huge undersea power led by the Cephalids encircling the continent.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: A figure whose corpse impaled by the Mirari sword lay in the Well of Spirits.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: The character who left the Mirari in the ground where Gorgon Mount rose.

entities.name: Aboshan
entities.description: Ruler of the Mer Empire who used the Mirari to smash the Aboshan Trench.

entities.name: Llawan
entities.description: Took over the Mer Empire after Aboshan's death.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: A war that led to the Nightmare War.

entities.name: Nightmare War
entities.description: A war that led to Karona's War.

entities.name: Karona's War
entities.description: War following the Nightmare War, which devastated Otaria.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The war Otaria survived relatively unscathed.

entities.name: Primeval Dragons
entities.description: Cruel rulers overthrown by the earliest known humans.

events.summary: The earliest humans overthrow the Primeval Dragons and form a huge empire based in Otaria.
events.quote: These people overthrew their draconic masters and formed a huge empire based in Otaria.

events.summary: Otaria survives the Phyrexian Invasion relatively unscathed and takes in refugees.
events.quote: It had survived that war relatively unscathed and was one of the first areas to recover and grow powerful once more.

events.summary: A century after the Invasion the Mirari appears, starting wars that devastate the continent.
events.quote: A century after the Invasion, the Mirari appeared there, initiating a series of destructive wars that devastated much of the continent.

events.summary: The destruction sends Otaria's aven fleeing to Benalia and New Argive.
events.quote: This massive destruction sent Otaria's aven population fleeing to Benalia and New Argive .

relations.quote: Otaria is a long and thin continent, running North-South, on Dominaria .
from where Aboshan ruled until his death, when Llawan took over.
